images.caption: Navaornis is an enantiornithean bird from the Late Cretaceous of what is now Brazil. Enantiornithes typically had teeth in their beaks, but Navaornis seems to have been toothless. Aside from the claws that they often retained on their wings, these small theropods essentially resembled modern birds. Navaornis grew to about 15 cm in length.
